svg.title: Parallel Run
svg.desc: Parallel Run. Run old and new side by side on the same inputs and compare results before cutting over. Step 1, Same input to both: Every request goes to both. Old answers the caller; new is only recorded, with no real side effects. Step 2, Compare every result: A comparator checks every pair of results. 970 of 1,000 match (97%); the 30 mismatches are logged. Step 3, Explain every mismatch: Explain every mismatch: new-code defect, old quirk or noise. Fix and redeploy: 100%, and it holds. Step 4, Cut over: Zero mismatches for long enough: the roles swap. New answers now; old shadows a while, then retires.
